title: Tip:
tempFilter: Press and hold the filter icon to temporarily disable filters.
reportImages: Inappropriate images can be reported in the app.
imageView: Tapping an image in the detail view opens the gallery for this meal.
hint: Tips can also be displayed in the settings. Try tapping on it!
allergens: Meals can be filtered by allergens.
rate1: Meals can be rated with just one star to highlight them negatively.
favorite: Meals can be favorited to highlight them positively and easily access them.
imageVote: Images can be voted on so the best image represents the meal.
expandMeals: In the detail view, meals can be expanded to view nutritional values, eco score, and more.
priceCategories: In the settings, the price category can be changed.
openSource: The app's source code is available on GitHub. There you can suggest features and contribute to further development.
openAPI: You can also use the MensaKA App API for your own projects.
sort: You can change the order of meals in the filter settings.
